title: TransGHOST: Real-Time, Synthesis-Free Reconstruction of Instrument-Occluded Regions in Ophthalmic Microsurgery
summary: Intraoperative scene perception in ophthalmic microsurgery is limited by instrument occlusion: when a tool enters the high-magnification field, it conceals tissue from both the surgeon and the perception components of robot-assisted systems that process the video. Generative inpainting can remove the occluder but replaces the missing image content with synthesis, which is unsuitable when visual provenance matters. Many video inpainters also depend on future frames and cannot operate online. We present TransGHOST, a causal reference-guided reconstruction pipeline whose non-generative safe mode operates in real time. Every restored value is obtained by resampling a recorded frame using geometric transforms fitted only to visible regions. The system provides per-pixel confidence and provenance and marks unsupported pixels as abstentions. We evaluate TransGHOST on a new veterinary clinical corpus of canine cataract surgery with pixel-level instrument and anatomy labels. Only the occluded region is scored, and each scoring target is verified to differ from the reference supplied to the system. Safe mode reaches 31.89 dB masked PSNR and 0.915 masked SSIM at 51.7 ms median and 85.5 ms 95th-percentile latency. On a pre-declared held-out cohort using instrument cutouts excluded from segmentation training, it reaches 29.83 dB masked PSNR, while matched-mask evaluation on validation shows a 3.45 dB advantage over LaMa. Region-aware reference selection improves masked PSNR by 3.60 dB over recency when candidate references can themselves be occluded. Reference-age analysis further defines the operating interval for the brief, repeated occlusions targeted by TransGHOST.
tldr: TransGHOST is a causal, synthesis-free reconstruction pipeline for instrument-occluded regions in ophthalmic microsurgery. It restores occluded tissue by resampling recorded reference frames with geometric transforms fitted to visible regions, providing per-pixel confidence, provenance, and abstentions in real time, and outperforms generative inpainting on a new canine cataract surgery dataset.
tldr_zh: TransGHOST 是一种用于眼科显微手术中器械遮挡区域重建的因果、非生成式管线。它通过仅基于可见区域拟合几何变换并重采样已记录参考帧来恢复遮挡组织，提供逐像素置信度、来源可追溯性及弃权机制，实时运行，并在新的犬白内障手术数据集上优于生成式修复方法。
summary_zh: 眼科显微手术中的术中场景感知受到器械遮挡的限制：当工具进入高倍视野时，它会遮挡组织，使外科医生和机器人辅助系统中处理视频的感知组件都无法看到。生成式修复可以移除遮挡物，但会用合成内容替换缺失的图像区域，这在不适合依赖视觉来源的场景中存在问题。许多视频修复方法还依赖未来帧，无法在线运行。我们提出TransGHOST，一种因果参考引导的重建流程，其非生成式安全模式可实时运行。每个恢复值均通过仅拟合可见区域的几何变换对录制帧进行重采样获得。系统提供逐像素置信度与来源信息，并将不支持的像素标记为弃权。我们在一个新的兽医临床语料库——犬白内障手术数据集上评估TransGHOST，该数据集包含像素级器械与解剖标注。仅对遮挡区域进行评分，并验证每个评分目标与提供给系统的参考帧不同。安全模式在51.7毫秒中位数和85.5毫秒95分位延迟下达到31.89 dB掩膜PSNR和0.915掩膜SSIM。在预先声明的留出队列上，使用未参与分割训练的器械剪切块进行评估时，系统达到29.83 dB掩膜PSNR，而在验证集上的匹配掩膜评估显示，其比LaMa优势达3.45 dB。当候选参考帧本身可能被遮挡时，区域感知的参考选择比最近帧选择提升3.60 dB掩膜PSNR。参考时效分析进一步界定了TransGHOST所针对的短暂重复遮挡的工作区间。

title: PneuGen: Task-Driven Agentic Co-Design of Soft Pneumatic Robots
summary: Task-driven design of soft robots requires the consideration of factors such as geometry, morphology, material properties, and actuation, resulting in a large and complex design space that is challenging to explore. Computational optimisation methods leverage signals from simulation to iteratively improve designs to achieve task objectives. However, these methods typically demand high computational load for both optimisation and simulation. We present PneuGen, an agentic co-design framework for soft robots that leverages Large Language Model (LLM) agents to search over the soft robot design space efficiently. A designer agent proposes design programs from a parametric component library, and a separate critic agent analyses simulation diagnostics and recommends targeted revisions. Fitted module response models provide reusable physical priors relating geometry and pressure to deformation. Design programs are automatically validated and converted into finite-element simulations, enabling iterative evaluation. Across grasping tasks on primitive shapes and challenging objects, as well as shape-matching tasks that require multi-directional planar and 3D deformation, the proposed framework significantly outperforms prior computational optimisation baselines. Ablation experiments also highlight the utility of the critic agent and the module response model in facilitating efficient design. We additionally demonstrate the agent-generated soft robot designs in real-world shape-matching and grasping tasks.
tldr: PneuGen uses LLM agents (designer + critic) with reusable module response models and finite-element simulation to co-design soft pneumatic robots efficiently, outperforming computational optimization baselines on grasping and shape-matching tasks and showing real-world viability.
tldr_zh: PneuGen 采用大语言模型智能体（设计者+评论者），结合可复用模块响应模型和有限元仿真，高效协同设计软体气动机器人；在抓取和形状匹配任务上优于计算优化基线，并验证了实物可行性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
软体机器人的任务驱动设计需要考虑几何、形态、材料属性及驱动方式等因素，由此产生庞大而复杂的设计空间，难以有效探索。计算优化方法利用仿真信号迭代改进设计，以达成任务目标，但此类方法通常在优化和仿真两方面的计算负担都很大。我们提出PneuGen，一种面向软体机器人的智能体协同设计框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）智能体高效搜索软体机器人设计空间。设计智能体从参数化组件库中提出设计程序，独立的评审智能体分析仿真诊断结果并推荐针对性修改。拟合的模块响应模型提供了将几何和压力与变形相关联的可复用物理先验。设计程序自动验证并转换为有限元仿真，实现迭代评估。在针对基本形状和挑战性物体的抓取任务以及需要多方向平面和三维变形的形状匹配任务中，所提框架显著优于先前的计算优化基线。消融实验也突出了评审智能体和模块响应模型在促进高效设计方面的作用。我们还在真实世界的形状匹配和抓取任务中验证了智能体生成的软体机器人设计。

title: Simulating Vein Compressibility for Ultrasound-Guided Femoral Access: Speed, Accuracy, and Phantom Validation
summary: In ultrasound-guided femoral access, probe pressure deforms the tissue and changes the vascular anatomy a robot observes. A simulator must reproduce these mechanics fast enough for robotic interaction, yet the computational effort needed for a clinically meaningful signal like vein collapse before artery is unclear. We test the feasibility of a physics-based simulation in NVIDIA's Isaac Sim for Healthcare, with Stable Neo-Hookean tissue solved by Vertex Block Descent on one GPU. A simulation of a low-fidelity cylindrical benchtop phantom with known geometry and mechanical properties, pressed by a robot, predicted its artery within 5 percentage points at every depth. It matched the vein within 3 points through 11 mm of a 25.4 mm press and followed the collapse behavior of the low-fidelity physical phantom. Across element size, time step, and solver iterations, wall clock time per frame scaled linearly with solver work, but accuracy did not improve with more work. The chosen setting reduced solver time per frame by a factor of 976, from 29,700 ms to 30.4 ms, while remaining within 1.03 points of the finest reference setting. The physics solver alone took 30.4 ms per frame, while the full stack, including ultrasound and graphics rendering, took 56.4 ms per frame. Finally, when seeded with realistic literature-based mechanical properties, the digital leg model compressed the vein far more than the artery at every setting, reproducing the expected clinical signal of vein collapse before artery, which is used to distinguish them. In total, these results suggest that the NVIDIA Isaac Sim platform may be suitable for augmenting reinforcement learning training or online simulation for autonomous femoral access with ultrasound.
tldr: This paper evaluates a GPU-based physics simulator in NVIDIA Isaac Sim for Healthcare to reproduce vein collapse under probe pressure during ultrasound-guided femoral access. It reports real-time frame rates and good agreement with phantoms, suggesting feasibility for reinforcement learning training or online simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了NVIDIA Isaac Sim for Healthcare中基于GPU的物理模拟器，用于再现超声引导股动脉穿刺中探头压力下静脉塌陷的力学行为。结果表明帧率可满足实时性要求，且与体模实验一致性较好，有望用于强化学习训练或在线仿真。
summary_zh:
摘要：
在超声引导下的股动脉入路中，探头压力会使组织变形，从而改变机器人观察到的血管解剖结构。模拟器必须足够快地重现这些力学特性以支持机器人交互，然而，产生诸如“静脉先于动脉塌陷”这类具有临床意义的信号所需的计算量尚不明确。我们在NVIDIA Isaac Sim for Healthcare平台上测试了一种基于物理的仿真的可行性，该仿真采用由顶点块下降法（Vertex Block Descent）在单个GPU上求解的稳定Neo-Hookean组织模型。一个已知几何形状和力学属性的低保真圆柱形台架仿体在机器人按压下的仿真，在每个深度对动脉的预测误差均在5个百分点以内；在25.4 mm按压行程的前11 mm内，对静脉的匹配误差在3个百分点以内，并复现了该低保真物理仿体的塌陷行为。在单元尺寸、时间步长和求解器迭代次数变化时，每帧墙钟时间与求解器工作量呈线性关系，但增加计算量并未提高精度。所选设置将每帧求解器时间减少了976倍，从29,700毫秒降至30.4毫秒，同时与最精细的参考设置相比，误差保持在1.03个百分点以内。仅物理求解器每帧耗时30.4毫秒，而包括超声成像和图形渲染在内的完整技术栈每帧耗时56.4毫秒。最后，当采用基于文献的、符合实际的力学属性进行初始化时，数字腿部模型在所有设置下均使静脉压缩程度远大于动脉，复现了预期的“静脉先于动脉塌陷”这一用于区分静脉和动脉的临床信号。总体而言，这些结果表明，NVIDIA Isaac Sim平台可能适用于增强强化学习训练，或用于超声引导下自主股动脉入路的在线仿真。

title: BioMem: Agentic Memory for Biomedical LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable potential in biomedical applications, while agentic memory systems have emerged as a promising approach to preserving and utilizing information across tasks and interactions. However, a fundamental question remains: how effectively and reliably do these systems retain, retrieve, update, and utilize biomedical information? In this study, we systematically investigate agentic memory in the biomedical domain, focusing on task effectiveness, retrieval quality, information fidelity, and long-term robustness. We evaluate five memory approaches across four LLMs in three representative settings: biomedical knowledge reasoning, clinical prediction, and long-term conversational memory. Our analyses reveal how memory construction, evidence relevance, and conversational history shape downstream biomedical performance, highlighting the distinct challenges of retrieving relevant information, preserving its fidelity, and effectively utilizing it for reasoning. Building on these findings, we introduce Hybrid Memory Retrieval and Utilization (HMRU), a training-free framework that jointly enhances evidence accessibility and task-aware utilization to improve biomedical reasoning and long-term conversational memory. HMRU achieves an average relative improvement of 8.6% across biomedical question-answering and conversational memory benchmarks, with additional gains in selected clinical prediction tasks. It further reduces conversational answer errors by 24.9% and closes 48.0% of the performance gap to full-context inference. Our findings provide a systematic characterization of biomedical agentic memory and practical insights into developing more effective and reliable memory-augmented LLM systems.
tldr: This paper systematically investigates agentic memory for biomedical LLM agents across multiple models and tasks, revealing key limitations in retrieval, fidelity, and reasoning, and proposes HMRU, a training-free hybrid memory retrieval and utilization framework that improves biomedical question answering and long-term conversational memory while reducing conversational errors.
tldr_zh: 本文系统研究了生物医学LLM智能体的智能体记忆能力，涵盖多种模型与任务，揭示了检索、信息保真和推理方面的关键局限，并提出了无需训练的混合记忆检索与利用框架HMRU，可提升生物医学问答和长期对话记忆表现，同时减少对话错误。
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在生物医学应用中已展现出相当大的潜力，而智能体记忆系统（agentic memory systems）作为一种跨任务与交互保存和利用信息的新兴途径也日益受到关注。然而，一个根本性问题仍然存在：这些系统在保留、检索、更新和利用生物医学信息方面究竟表现如何，是否可靠？在本研究中，我们系统性地考察了生物医学领域的智能体记忆，重点关注任务有效性、检索质量、信息保真度和长期稳健性。我们在四种大语言模型上评估了五种记忆方法，覆盖三个代表性场景：生物医学知识推理、临床预测和长期对话记忆。我们的分析揭示了记忆构建、证据相关性和对话历史如何影响下游生物医学性能，并凸显了在检索相关信息、保持其保真度以及有效利用其进行推理方面所面临的独特挑战。基于这些发现，我们提出了混合记忆检索与利用框架（Hybrid Memory Retrieval and Utilization，HMRU），这是一种无需训练的框架，通过联合增强证据可获取性和任务感知利用能力，来改善生物医学推理和长期对话记忆。HMRU在生物医学问答和对话记忆基准测试中实现了平均8.6%的相对提升，并在部分临床预测任务中获得了额外增益。此外，它将对话回答错误率降低了24.9%，并弥合了与全上下文推断之间48.0%的性能差距。我们的研究为生物医学智能体记忆提供了系统性刻画，并为开发更有效、更可靠的记忆增强型大语言模型系统提供了实践性见解。

title: Softness is something you also need! Why compliance helps control: information metrics of a passive walker with compliant ankle
summary:
A great gap in adaptivity, flexibility, and dexterity still exists between intelligent robots, whether they are made of rigid or (partially) compliant components, and their naturally evolved animal and vegetal counterparts. One reason could be of `paradigm' nature. On the one hand, most robots (both rigid and soft) are still designed by following a `Cartesian' approach, with top-down control and a clear mind-body separation. Designing artificial agents on the basis of the principles that we observe in biology is not an easy task. The principles of organization of animals and plants rely on morphological computation and emergence of fit behaviors from loosely coupled networks of embodied agents.
  Modeling and control require radically new approaches. In this paper we briefly recall and explain some seminal mathematical results linking information metrics and dynamics of the agents, already published years ago; we integrate them with some recent methods developed by us and by the community, we highlight some brief remarks about their relevance and we hint to our current and near future work towards finding concrete and efficient ways for the modeling and control of completely or partially compliant artificial agents and for a better understanding of physical intelligence in nature. We present a technical note summarizing phase-space volume calculations for inverted-pendulum and passive-dynamic walking models, following our proposed framework. Starting from the McGeer compass gait, we introduce knee-ankle compliance, foot-rocker effects, and a Ruina-style compass gait with distributed leg inertia. Standard heel-strike maps are derived and used in the estimation of viable phase-space volumes $W(γ)$, based on a state-dependent Monte-Carlo and Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces methods. We show how the methods based on RKHS allow deeper and more subtle analysis.
tldr: This paper argues that compliance aids control via morphological computation, and presents a technical note on phase-space volume estimation for passive-dynamic walkers with compliant ankles using Monte-Carlo and RKHS methods.
tldr_zh: 本文主张柔顺性通过形态计算有助于控制，并介绍了利用蒙特卡洛和RKHS方法对具有柔顺踝部的被动动力行走器进行相空间体积估计的技术性说明。
summary_zh:
智能机器人，无论是刚性的还是（部分）柔顺的，与自然进化出的动物和植物对应体之间，在适应性、灵活性和灵巧性方面仍存在巨大差距。原因之一可能在于“范式”本质。一方面，大多数机器人（包括刚性和软体机器人）仍然遵循“笛卡尔”式方法设计，采用自上而下的控制，心身截然分离。基于我们在生物学中观察到的原则来设计人工代理并非易事。动物和植物的组织原则依赖于形态计算，以及从松散耦合的具身代理网络中涌现出的适配行为。

建模与控制需要全新的方法。本文简要回顾并解释了若干具有开创性的数学成果，这些成果将信息度量与代理动力学联系起来，多年前已经发表；我们将它们与我们自己和学术界近期开发的一些方法相结合，简要评述其相关性，并展望我们当前及近期的工作，旨在寻找对完全或部分柔顺人工代理进行建模和控制的具体高效途径，以及更好地理解自然界中的物理智能。我们提供了一份技术笔记，总结了我们提出的框架下倒立摆和被动动态行走模型的相空间体积计算。从McGeer指南针步态出发，我们引入了膝踝柔顺性、足部摇杆效应，以及具有分布腿部惯性的Ruina式指南针步态。推导了标准足跟撞击映射，并基于状态依赖的蒙特卡洛和再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）方法，用于估计可行的相空间体积$W(γ)$。我们展示了基于RKHS的方法如何实现更深入、更精细的分析。

title: HandsOnAid: Building and Evaluating an Offline First-Aid Assistant for Emergency Response Scenarios
summary: Emergencies can occur where there is no phone signal and no ambulance nearby. A small language model on a phone can be helpful in such situations, but its advice needs to be safe and accurate. We built HandsOnAid, a 4-bit Gemma 2B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on FirstAidQA dataset, a corpus of 5,550 first-aid question-answer pairs. We compared seven configurations, including the base, 4-bit and 8-bit fine-tuned models, and versions with a length floor, safety gate, or retrieval. We used a 41-pair question-answer bank with medically reviewed references that followed ANZCOR guidelines, and a strict 0-5 score rubric, with twelve safety overrides. Four frontier LLM judges (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3) blindly scored every answer, with 45 hidden controls used to check judge reliability. Fine-tuning improved the mean score by +1.08 over the base model to 2.34. The best configuration scored 2.51 out of 5 which was the fine-tuned 4-bit model with retrieval. A medical professional also conducted a blind evaluation of 40 answers across the base, the 4-bit fine-tuned, and the retrieval configurations, and the scores were similar to the LLM judges' average scores. A keyword audit found limited coverage of several details of ANZCOR guidelines in the training corpus, that are required by the rubric, which suggests that missing information in the training data could be a cause of the low scores. On a smartphone device (Pixel 7 Pro) with six CPU threads and no network connection, the 4-bit fine-tuned model produced its first displayable text in 6.86 seconds and a complete answer in 14.88 seconds on average over ten questions.
tldr: HandsOnAid is an offline first-aid assistant built by fine-tuning a 4-bit Gemma 2B model on 5,550 QA pairs, with retrieval, safety gating, and latency evaluation. The best configuration achieved 2.51/5 under strict ANZCOR-based scoring, indicating limited guideline coverage and modest answer quality despite practical offline deployment.
tldr_zh: HandsOnAid 是一个离线急救助手，通过对 5,550 个问答对微调 4-bit Gemma 2B 模型构建，并评估了检索、安全门控和延迟等配置。在基于 ANZCOR 指南的严格评分下，最佳配置得分为 2.51/5，表明指南覆盖不足且回答质量有限，但可在手机上离线运行。
summary_zh:
摘要：
在无手机信号且附近没有救护车的紧急情况下，手机上的小型语言模型可以提供帮助，但其建议必须安全且准确。我们构建了HandsOnAid，这是一个4位量化的Gemma 2B模型，使用QLoRA在FirstAidQA数据集（包含5,550对急救问答的语料库）上进行微调。我们比较了七种配置，包括基础模型、4位和8位微调模型，以及加入长度下限、安全门或检索的版本。我们使用了一个包含41对问答的题库，其中参考答案经过医学审核并遵循ANZCOR指南，同时采用严格的0-5分评分标准，并设有十二项安全否决条件。四个前沿LLM评审（GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5、DeepSeek V4 Pro、GLM-5.3）对所有答案进行盲评，并设置了45个隐藏对照以检验评审可靠性。微调使平均分比基础模型提高了+1.08，达到2.34分。最佳配置是添加了检索的4位微调模型，得分为2.51分（满分5分）。一位医学专业人员还对基础配置、4位微调配置和检索配置中的40个答案进行了盲评，其评分与LLM评审的平均分相近。关键词审计发现，训练语料中ANZCOR指南若干细节的覆盖有限，而这些细节是评分标准所要求的，这表明训练数据中缺失信息可能是得分较低的原因之一。在智能手机设备（Pixel 7 Pro）上，使用六个CPU线程且无网络连接时，4位微调模型平均首屏文本生成时间为6.86秒，完成完整回答平均需要14.88秒（基于十个问题）。

title: Towards Scalable Network-Based Interventions for HIV Treatment and Prevention via R2C-Agent
summary: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) remains a pressing public health challenge worldwide. Targeting limited HIV prevention and treatment resources effectively with network-based algorithms is a long-standing problem with a rich history at AAMAS and other computational venues. However, optimizing targeted biomedical interventions for minimizing spread of HIV often requires observability of the contact network of HIV transmission risk behavior among individuals, which is prohibitively expensive to collect at scale. Peer referral networks, i.e., networks collected through a recursive peer referral process, are an alternative network class often used to study HIV in hidden populations that can be collected digitally at scale, but they deviate from the underlying contact network: referrals can follow non-risk social ties and participants accept only one referral, hiding contacts among already-recruited individuals. In this work, we first formalize the novel problem of planning network-based interventions to minimize HIV spread in the hidden contact network while observing only the peer referral network. Second, we implement R2C-Agent, a decision making agent for interventions that is designed around our new conditional graph diffusion model called Referral-to-Contact Diffusion (R2C-Diff). R2C-Diff positions the peer referral process as incremental corruption of the underlying contact network and learns to reverse it. R2C-Agent plans its interventions over contact networks sampled from R2C-Diff, so its decisions account for uncertainty about the hidden contact network. Finally, we conduct simulated experiments using real-world HIV network data that demonstrate that R2C-Agent empirically plans more effective interventions than baselines from interdisciplinary literature and highlight key tradeoffs and assumptions driving performance.
tldr: The paper introduces R2C-Agent, a decision-making agent for HIV intervention planning that uses a novel conditional graph diffusion model (R2C-Diff) to reconstruct hidden contact networks from observable peer referral networks, then plans interventions over sampled contact networks; simulated experiments on real-world HIV data show improved effectiveness over baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出R2C-Agent，一种用于HIV干预规划的决策智能体，利用新的条件图扩散模型R2C-Diff从可观测的同伴转介网络重建隐藏接触网络，并在采样的接触网络上规划干预；基于真实HIV网络数据的模拟实验显示其效果优于基线。
summary_zh:
摘要：
人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）仍然是全球紧迫的公共卫生挑战。利用基于网络的算法有效配置有限的HIV预防和治疗资源是一个长期存在的问题，在AAMAS及其他计算领域有着丰富的研究历史。然而，优化针对性的生物医学干预以最小化HIV传播，往往需要可观测个体间HIV传播风险行为的接触网络，而大规模收集此类网络的成本高得令人望而却步。同伴推荐网络，即通过递归同伴推荐过程收集的网络，是常用于研究隐藏人群中HIV的一种替代网络类型，可以通过数字化方式大规模收集，但它们偏离了底层接触网络：推荐可能沿非风险社会关系进行，且参与者只接受一次推荐，从而隐藏了已被招募个体之间的接触。在这项工作中，我们首先形式化了一个新问题：在仅观测同伴推荐网络的情况下，规划基于网络的干预措施以最小化隐藏接触网络中的HIV传播。其次，我们实现了R2C-Agent，这是一个围绕我们新提出的条件图扩散模型——推荐到接触扩散（R2C-Diff）——设计的干预决策智能体。R2C-Diff将同伴推荐过程视为对底层接触网络的逐步破坏，并学习逆转这一过程。R2C-Agent在从R2C-Diff采样的接触网络上规划干预，因此其决策考虑了隐藏接触网络的不确定性。最后，我们使用真实世界HIV网络数据进行模拟实验，结果表明R2C-Agent在经验上比跨学科文献中的基线方法规划出更有效的干预措施，并突出了驱动性能的关键权衡和假设。

title: Decisions by Discrimination: Differential Evidence for Medical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly studied for clinical decision support, and medical question answering provides a testbed for evaluating this capability. In particular, medical multiple-choice questions (MCQs) reflect a core challenge in clinical decision-making: plausible options often share overlapping evidence, while only a few decisive factors distinguish the correct option from incorrect ones. However, existing retrieval-based and reasoning-oriented methods mainly focus on supplying broadly relevant knowledge or eliciting reasoning paths, rather than identifying the compact differential evidence that separates confusing alternatives. In this work, we present a retrieval-grounded differential evidence framework for medical MCQs. Our method extracts option-specific pieces of differential evidence and organizes them into concise evidence prompts for answer selection. This design better aligns external knowledge with differential reasoning while reducing irrelevant context. Experiments show consistent accuracy gains across multiple datasets and target LLMs. Ablation studies further show that our framework outperforms both directly using retrieved evidence chunks and closed-source LLM-generated general hints, and that its improvements are not solely explained by answer-proximal guidance, but are consistent with differential evidence serving as a compact aid for reasoning over competing alternatives. Our findings also offer insights for medical reasoning and other decision-making settings with multiple possible choices.
tldr: Proposes a retrieval-grounded differential evidence framework that extracts concise option-specific evidence to help LLMs answer medical multiple-choice questions, improving accuracy across datasets and target LLMs.
tldr_zh: 提出一种检索增强的差异证据框架，用于医疗多选题回答：提取选项间区分性证据并组织成简洁提示，以提升大语言模型在临床推理中的准确率。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在临床决策支持中的应用日益受到关注，而医学问答为评估该能力提供了试验平台。特别是，医学选择题（MCQs）反映了临床决策中的核心挑战：看似合理的选项往往共享重叠的证据，而仅有少数决定性因素能将正确选项与错误选项区分开来。然而，现有的基于检索的方法和面向推理的方法主要侧重于提供广泛相关的知识或引导推理路径，而非识别能够区分混淆选项的紧凑差异性证据。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于检索的差异性证据框架，用于医学选择题。我们的方法提取选项特异性的差异性证据片段，并将其组织为简洁的证据提示，以支持答案选择。该设计更好地将外部知识与差异性推理对齐，同时减少了不相关上下文。实验表明，在多个数据集和目标大型语言模型上均取得了一致的准确率提升。消融研究进一步表明，我们的框架优于直接使用检索到的证据块以及闭源大语言模型生成的通用提示，且其改进不能仅通过答案邻近性引导来解释，而是与差异性证据作为竞争选项间推理的紧凑辅助工具相一致。我们的研究结果也为医学推理及其他具有多个可能选项的决策场景提供了洞见。

title: Rethinking Evaluation for Video Capsule Endoscopy: Validation Protocol, Source-Video Diversity, and Cross-Dataset Shift
summary: Automated video capsule endoscopy (VCE) classification remains challenging due to severe class imbalance, limited source-video diversity, and variations in image appearance across datasets. Although deep learning models have demonstrated promising performance on established benchmarks, their reliability under different validation protocols and external dataset shift remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce DMSNet, a deformable adaptive multi-scale edge-guided attention network integrating adaptive multi-scale feature fusion, deformable lesion refinement, edge-guided attention, and sparse feature selection. We benchmark DMSNet against 18 representative convolutional, transformer-based, and pretrained vision architectures on Kvasir-Capsule under random frame-level and source-video-disjoint validation protocols. We further identify source-video overlap between the original training and test splits and evaluate model performance on both the complete test set and a source-video-disjoint subset. Under random frame-level validation, DMSNet achieves an MCC of 0.442 $\pm$ 0.020 on complete test set and 0.456 $\pm$ 0.037 on the source-video-disjoint subset. On the external CV2024 dataset, ConvNeXt-Tiny achieves the highest MCC of 0.207, while performance degrades substantially across architectures relative to in-domain evaluation. We further investigate source-video diversity using a per-class cap of 200 training frames. With the total training-set size held fixed, increasing the maximum source-video coverage from four to eight improves MCC for 17 of 19 evaluated architectures. Overall, these findings demonstrate that model rankings and classification performance depend substantially on evaluation protocol, training-source diversity, and cross-dataset shift, emphasizing the need for source-aware validation and rigorous external evaluation of VCE classification systems.
tldr: This paper proposes DMSNet, a deformable multi-scale edge-guided attention network for video capsule endoscopy classification, and systematically studies how validation protocols, source-video diversity, and cross-dataset shift affect model rankings and performance. It shows source-video-disjoint evaluation and external datasets substantially change results.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了用于视频胶囊内镜分类的DMSNet（可变形自适应多尺度边缘引导注意力网络），并系统研究了验证协议、源视频多样性和跨数据集偏移对模型排名及性能的影响，发现源视频不重叠评估与外部数据集会显著改变结论。
summary_zh: 自动视频胶囊内镜（VCE）分类仍然具有挑战性，主要原因在于严重的类别不平衡、源视频多样性有限以及不同数据集之间图像外观的差异。尽管深度学习模型已在既有基准上展现出令人瞩目的性能，但其在不同验证协议和外部数据集偏移下的可靠性仍未得到充分理解。在本工作中，我们提出了DMSNet，一种可变形自适应多尺度边缘引导注意力网络，集成了自适应多尺度特征融合、可变形病变精化、边缘引导注意力以及稀疏特征选择。我们在Kvasir-Capsule上，于随机帧级验证协议和源视频不相交验证协议下，将DMSNet与18种具有代表性的卷积、基于Transformer的以及预训练视觉架构进行了基准比较。我们进一步识别了原始训练集与测试集之间的源视频重叠，并在完整测试集和源视频不相交子集上评估了模型性能。在随机帧级验证下，DMSNet在完整测试集上取得的MCC为0.442 ± 0.020，在源视频不相交子集上为0.456 ± 0.037。在外部CV2024数据集上，ConvNeXt-Tiny取得了最高的MCC为0.207，而各架构的性能相对于域内评估均显著下降。我们还使用每类200帧训练帧的上限进一步研究了源视频多样性。在保持总训练集规模固定的情况下，将最大源视频覆盖数从4增加到8，使19种评估架构中的17种MCC得到提升。总体而言，这些发现表明，模型排名和分类性能在很大程度上取决于评估协议、训练源多样性以及跨数据集偏移，强调了对VCE分类系统进行源感知验证和严格外部评估的必要性。
